content: Do I need to lift heavy to build muscle?

No, you don't have to lift heavy to build muscle. Research shows that sets taken close to failure (about 0-3 reps left in the tank) build similar muscle across a wide range of loads, roughly 5 to 30 reps. Lighter weights just take more reps and more fatigue to get there. 💪

Your 100 kg bench goal is a strength goal, though, so you'll still need heavy sets in the 3-8 rep range to practice the lift. Use heavy work for the bench and moderate reps (8-15) for accessories. Ain't nothin' but a peanut!
